standard-dialogue.npc: Pardon me, there are important duties which require my attention. Good day to you.

dialogue-after-unlocking-butler-s-bell.npc: Ah [player name], a pleasure to see you here. Do you need anything?
If so, please do ring the bell as agreed. I cannot serve you otherwise.
It is a contractual matter, I'm sure that you understand.

dialogue-after-unlocking-butler-s-bell.player: Actually, I do have one question if you don't mind?
If I ring my bell in here, won't there be two of you?

dialogue-after-unlocking-butler-s-bell.npc: Ah! This is always a sore point for mortals. The answer is both yes and no.
Presence is more complicated than you might think! There are ways to inhabit many places, and indeed many times, within what you would call the same moment.
Oh but it does! Though I fear that to you, it may never.
I must see to my other tasks now. Goodbye.
